info.name: HRM System API
info.description:
End-to-end checks for the HRM backend, per role.

1. Import this collection and `HRM.local.postman_environment.json`, select the **HRM Local** environment.
2. Set `password` in the environment to your `Seed:DefaultPassword` user-secret.
3. Start the API (`dotnet run --project src/HRM.API --launch-profile http` from `hrm-server/`).
4. Run the collection with the Collection Runner, or send requests one by one starting with **00 Setup**.

Login is limited to 5 per minute per IP: folders 00-06 use 5 logins, so wait a minute before running **07 Logout**.
Re-runs are safe: new records get unique names and leave dates are random weekdays 1-2 years ahead.

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Logs in one account per role and looks up ids used by later requests. Run this folder first.

exec: pm.test("Role is HR with 11 permissions", () => { pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql("HR"); pm.expect(body.user.permissions.length).to.eql(11); });
// The refresh token is only in the HttpOnly cookie; keep it to call /refresh and /logout explicitly.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Who am I, refresh rotation, generic login errors and the admin-only endpoint.

request.description: Counts towards the 5-per-minute login limit and the 5-failure lockout.

exec: pm.test("Generic message, no account enumeration", () => pm.expect(body.detail).to.eql("Invalid email or password."));
pm.test("A new refresh token was issued", () => pm.expect(rotated !== pm.collectionVariables.get("employeeRefresh")).to.be.true);

item.name: Reuse the old refresh token (theft detection)

request.description: A revoked token presented again revokes ALL of the user's sessions.

item.name: Refresh again after reuse (all sessions revoked)

request.description: The access token keeps working until it expires (15 min); only refresh is cut off.

item.name: 02 Departments
item.description: Everyone can read; only HR and Admin can change.

item.name: 03 Employees
item.description: Data scope: Admin/HR see everyone, a Manager their department, an Employee only themselves. Out-of-scope records return 404.

item.name: Get a Sales employee as Manager -> 404
Get a Sales employee as Employee -> 404

exec: pm.test("Errors for FirstName, Email, Phone", () => pm.expect(["FirstName", "Email", "Phone"].every(f => f in body.errors)).to.be.true);

item.name: Manager no longer sees the transferred employee -> 404
04 Leave
item.description: Submit, review (Manager for own department, HR for everyone), cancel, reject. Business-rule failures return 422.

exec: const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + 30 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 700));
pm.test("Approved by Minh Nguyen", () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("Approved"); pm.expect(r.reviewedByName).to.eql("Minh Nguyen"); });
const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + 30 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 700));
const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + 30 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 700));

item.name: 05 Attendance
item.description: Server-side times; one check-in per day. Safe to re-run on the same day (accepts 'already done').

exec: pm.test("Status 200 or 409 (409 = already checked in today)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 409]));
pm.test("Status 200 or 422 (422 = already checked out today)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 422]));
pm.test("Huy Le is checked out", () => pm.expect(body.items.find(i => i.employeeName === "Huy Le").status).to.eql("CheckedOut"));

request.description: Uses a second HR account. This is the collection's 6th login: run folders 00-06 and this one more than a minute apart, or you'll get 429 (login rate limit).
